evidence: Removes 117 lines from src/util/expected.h, deletes src/util/types.h, and replaces shims in src/compat/byteswap.h with standard library equivalents.
rationale: Retiring custom utility polyfills for expected types and byteswapping in favor of std::expected and std::byteswap modernizes core utilities. This removes internal maintenance burden across shared utility headers without changing runtime node behavior.
